name: Safe zones for vertical short video
units: Pixels on a 1080 x 1920 frame, x from the left edge, y from the top. Scale by width/1080 and height/1920 for other sizes.
boxShape: A box is the area the app leaves clear: left, right, top, bottom. From y = railTop down, a button column pushes the right edge in to x = railLeft. With no column, railTop equals bottom and railLeft equals right.
note: Each app's box is the safe area in that app's own 9:16 ad guidance; the apps publish no pixel figures for regular posts. What an app covers changes with the placement, the caption's length, the reading direction and the app version, so these are the published presets, not a guarantee. clearOnEvery is the intersection of the four boxes here.

tiktok.name: TikTok
covers: like, comment, save and share column on the right from y = 840
account name, caption and sound at the bottom (a longer caption covers more)
